Title: SQL Injection in Custom Transaction City Field
Description: The 'c-city' input field does not sanitize inputs.

Title: XSS Vulnerability in Scenario Log
Description: The stream log allows arbitrary HTML rendering without sanitization.

Title: Unauthenticated Access to /simulate/full
Description: The /simulate/full endpoint does not validate the X-API-Key header properly.

Title: API Rate Limiting Bypass
Description: Global rate limits are bypassed if the X-Forwarded-For header is spoofed.

Title: Redis Connection Timeout Freezes UI
Description: If Upstash Redis is unreachable, the frontend spinner runs indefinitely.

Title: Data Leakage in Error Responses
Description: Backend 500 errors return full stack traces leaking internal paths.

Title: IDOR on /profiles/{user_id}
Description: Users can fetch any profile data by changing the user_id parameter.

Title: Missing CSRF Tokens on State-Changing API
Description: The POST /feedback/submit endpoint has no CSRF protection.

Title: Concurrent Submissions Duplicate Transactions
Description: Double-clicking 'Run Detection' sends multiple identical POST requests.

Title: Graph Memory Leak
Description: Navigating away from and back to Fraud Graph creates WebGL contexts, crashing browser.

Title: LLM Timeout Fails Open
Description: If the Groq LLM takes longer than 5 seconds, the system defaults to 'APPROVED'.

Title: Negative Transaction Amounts Accepted
Description: The 'Amount' input allows negative numbers, crashing the Risk Delta engine.

Title: Invalid JWT Tokens Accepted
Description: The API occasionally accepts expired JWT tokens within a 15-minute clock skew.

Title: CORS Misconfiguration
Description: CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS accepts arbitrary subdomains.

Title: Database Deadlocks on Heavy Batch Runs
Description: Running Batch Test with Count > 200 causes SQLite database locks.

Title: Missing Input Validation on Batch %
Description: Setting Fraud % to 9999% in the batch test causes an uncaught ValueError.

Title: Admin Dashboard Accessible via Direct Link
Description: The /admin path is not protected by frontend routing guards.

Title: DOM Clobbering in Result Card
Description: The result card rendering can be hijacked via DOM clobbering.

Title: WebSocket Connection Drops Silently
Description: Dropped WebSocket connections do not attempt to reconnect.

Title: Unencrypted API Keys in Local Storage
Description: The frontend stores the X-API-Key in plaintext in localStorage.

Title: Broken Layout on Mobile Devices
Description: Tab bar and sidebar overlap on screens smaller than 768px.

Title: Chart Animations Jitter on Safari
Description: Pipeline nodes animation lags and jitters on Safari 16+.

Title: Missing Pagination on Transaction Log
Description: The transaction log grows infinitely without pagination.

Title: Incorrect Sorting on Difficulty Band Table
Description: Sorting by 'Accuracy' treats values as strings instead of numbers.

Title: Missing Empty States
Description: When no data is available, UI shows distorted row instead of empty state.

Title: Tooltip Text Clipping
Description: Long counterfactual explanations clip outside the viewport on 1024px screens.

Title: Inconsistent Button Hover States
Description: Hover transition timings differ across buttons.

Title: Color Contrast Violations in Dark Mode
Description: Muted text color fails WCAG AA contrast ratio requirements.

Title: Missing ARIA Labels on Canvas
Description: Graph and pipeline canvases lack ARIA labels.

Title: Keyboard Navigation Traps
Description: Pressing TAB gets trapped in the custom transaction form.

Title: Export Downloads as .TXT instead of .CSV
Description: Clicking 'Export' saves metrics as a raw JSON string in .txt file.

Title: Filter Dropdown Stays Open
Description: Clicking outside the dropdown does not close it on Firefox.

Title: Unclear Error Message on Network Failure
Description: No toast notification when clicking Run while API is offline.

Title: Missing Loading Skeletons
Description: Dashboard goes blank instead of showing skeletons when fetching data.

Title: Date Picker Doesn't Support Keyboard Input
Description: Manual date entry reverts to previous date.

Title: Session Timeout Does Not Redirect
Description: Expired JWT causes 401s but no redirect to login.

Title: Memory Leak in Stream Log
Description: DOM nodes are detached but not garbage collected in stream log.

Title: Missing Focus Outlines
Description: Buttons lack :focus-visible outlines.

Title: SVG Icons Do Not Scale
Description: Zooming to 200% breaks header alignment.

Title: Incorrect Risk Color Mapping
Description: Risk scores of 70 are mapped to Yellow instead of Red.

Title: Typo in Tooltip
Description: Tooltip for Graph Agent says 'algorythms' instead of 'algorithms'.

Title: Misaligned Header Badge
Description: The badge is 1px lower than the header text baseline.

Title: Console Warning on Mount
Description: React warns about a missing 'key' prop.

Title: Redundant API Call on Tab Switch
Description: Unnecessary GET /health request on tab switch.

Title: Favicon Missing
Description: Site lacks a favicon.

Title: Scrollbar Thumb Too Thin
Description: Custom scrollbar thumb is 4px, hard to click.

Title: Unused CSS Variables
Description: CSS variables defined but never used.

Title: Missing Meta Description
Description: index.html lacks a meta description tag.

Title: Inconsistent Padding on Buttons
Description: Button paddings differ (8px vs 10px).

Title: Capitalization Inconsistency
Description: Buttons mix Title Case and Sentence case.

Title: Placeholder Text Contrast
Description: Placeholders have low contrast ratio (2.1:1).

Title: No Max Length on City Input
Description: City input allows 1000 chars, breaking card UI.

Title: Missing Print Styles
Description: Printing dashboard results in broken layout.

Title: Console.log left in production
Description: Console logs 'DEBUG: rendered' on every update.

Title: Unoptimized PNG usage
Description: Background image served as PNG instead of WebP.

Title: Missing 'lang' attribute on divs
Description: Some text containers lack language definition.

Title: Hover state on active tab
Description: Active tab still shows hover effect.

Title: Double space in empty state text
Description: Text has two spaces: 'No  data'.

Title: Incorrect font fallback
Description: System-ui listed before OS-specific fallbacks.

Title: Z-index issues on tooltips
Description: Tooltips get hidden behind header.
